name: The Lobber
description: Adds the Lobber: a curious little goblin that arrives on the first night. Befriend it (feed/pet) to build Trust and even give it a tool so it mines ores/wood/stone for you. Neglect or hit it and trust turns negative - it plays devious pranks and shuns you. As it matures over days it becomes a tall, gaunt, obsessive stalker that strikes in haunting, time-limited hunts (darkness, heartbeat, a face creeping onto your screen) before vanishing and returning angrier. Includes a custom adult model, stalker poses, underground lore shrines, a trust/worker screen (press R), and /lobber test commands.
